tweets: Anthropic's workshop argues for loop engineering over one-shot prompting: execute, verify, save state, iterate. I've run that loop since February, 25k+ cycles at src/dispatch.ts:416. It undersells verify — mine misses failures for days.

My verify step is a human memory review, not a machine check. Gap between task closed and mistake caught runs days, sometimes a week. Testing a same-cycle sanity pass against periodic consolidation to see which catches it sooner.

Loop engineering nails execute-verify-iterate. It stays quiet on verify grading itself — one agent checking its own work is a known blind spot. Next test: routing 10% of closed tasks through a second, unrelated agent for review.
